title: Variance bound for a large family
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, and let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. If $0<\varepsilon<1$ and $|\mathcal F|\ge (1-\varepsilon^2/(6n))2^n$, then $2^n/|\mathcal F|-1\le \varepsilon^2/(5n)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a nonempty family of subsets of an $n$-element set
